summary: Iteration 33 - Annual rent statements (manual per-tenancy + bulk + January auto scheduler), tenant self-service portal (private revocable link, HTML page with tenancy terms/rent schedule/receipts/repair form/year-nav), and overpayment planner on personal-home dashboard. BACKEND pytest 13/13 PASSED (test_iteration33.py). (1) POST /api/rentals/tenancies/{id}/statement {year}: 400 'Add the tenant's email address first' when tenant_email missing; 400 'No rent was due in <year>' when year predates tenancy; 200 {ok:true} for a valid year; stores a row in rent_statements. POST /api/rentals/statements {year} returns {sent, failed, skipped, no_email} with correct counts (no_email increments when tenant_email empty). GET /api/rentals/statements?year returns {tenancy_id: sent_at ISO}. (2) Portal: POST /api/rentals/tenancies/{id}/portal {origin_url} returns {url} ending in /api/t/<token>; second call is IDEMPOTENT (same token reused via `t.get('portal_token') or secrets.token_urlsafe(16)`); GET /api/rentals exposes portal_url and omits portal_token (confirmed via dict comp in rentals.py:138). DELETE revokes (clears portal_token+portal_origin). Public GET /api/t/{token} HTML page includes required anchors: tenancy-terms, deposit-status, rent-schedule, repair-form, prev-year, next-year, receipt-YYYY-MM for paid months, repair-sent-msg after ?reported=1. GET /api/t/{token}?year=2025 renders prior-year schedule with receipt links for paid months. GET /api/t/{token}/receipt/{YYYY-MM} 200 for a paid month with print-receipt button; 404 'No payment recorded for that month' for unpaid month. Revoked token returns 'no longer active' page (not 404). POST /api/t/{token}/repair multipart form (room, description, priority) returns 303 to ?reported=1, creates snag in db.snags with reported_by='Tenant: <name>' (visible in GET /api/snags). 10/day rate limit enforced (11th report returns 429 'Too many reports today'). (3) run_january_statements guard: early-returns if date.today().month != 1 (reviewed; not unit-testable in prod without monkeypatch, scheduler runs hourly inside statement_scheduler coroutine) - safe no-op outside January. FRONTEND (390x844, demo acct): Dashboard /: overpayment-planner card visible with overpay-slider, overpay-monthly-value='£100', overpay-lump-input, overpay-interest-saved=£23,339, overpay-term-cut='4y 5m', overpay-summary='Mortgage-free in 20y 7m instead of 25y 0m. Total interest £9...'. Lump sum £5000 input updated interest-saved £23,339 → £31,941 (client-side simulate() reactive). /rentals: send-all-statements button visible above tenancies when any tenant has email; TEST_UI33b tenancy card showed tenancy-statement-{tid}, tenancy-portal-{tid}, tenancy-renew-{tid}. Portal tap opened tenant-portal-sheet with tenant-portal-url (https://.../api/t/<token>), copy/share/preview/revoke buttons; revoke closed sheet and cleared portal_url. Statement tap triggered success toast. /tenancy-form?id=...: tenancy-statements-on/off and tenancy-receipts-on/off chips visible; tapping Off then Save persisted statements_auto=False via API (verified GET /api/rentals). Portal repair submission (POST /api/t/<token>/repair) 303, resulting snag visible on /snags screen as 'TEST_UI33b shower leak · TEST_UI33b Bathroom · medium · Tenant: TEST_UI33b Tenant'. All testIDs from spec reachable, no React Native red screen. Only cosmetic warnings (shadow* / pointerEvents deprecation from RN web). Project restored to purpose=investment, deposit=0 at end; test tenancy + snags cleaned up.
action_items: No blocking issues. All 13 backend tests pass; all required testIDs reachable; overpayment planner reactive; portal link create/share/revoke + repair → snag flow verified end-to-end.

OPTIONAL: Consider surfacing the Report-a-repair submission failures (e.g. 429) to the tenant with a visible banner in the GONE/wrap pattern. Currently the FastAPI 429 lands as a plain error page (acceptable but not branded).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/tenant_portal.py:39-66 send_statement() correctly short-circuits with 'skipped' when _year_rows is empty (year predates tenancy or empty tenancy); upserts rent_statements only on 'sent' - safe idempotency for January auto run.

routes/tenant_portal.py:105-113 run_january_statements guards month!=1 AND skips tenancies already in rent_statements AND respects statements_auto!=False AND tenant_email set - correct dedup + opt-out semantics.

routes/tenant_portal.py:131-138 create_portal uses `t.get('portal_token') or secrets.token_urlsafe(16)` - IDEMPOTENT (reuse token on repeat calls). origin_url stored on tenancy so GET /api/rentals can rebuild portal_url. 16-byte urlsafe (~22 chars) is adequate entropy.

routes/rentals.py:138-140 GET /api/rentals dict comprehension excludes 'portal_token' and 'portal_origin' from the response - prevents token leakage. Verified via test (assert 'portal_token' not in t).

routes/tenant_portal.py:157-205 tenant portal HTML includes all required anchor ids (tenancy-terms, deposit-status, rent-schedule, receipt-<month>, repair-form, prev-year, next-year, repair-sent-msg) - matches spec exactly. year nav uses GET params. Only recurring receipt link when r['paid'] > 0 (correct).

routes/tenant_portal.py:229-265 /t/{token}/repair enforces 10/day rate limit per tenancy via count_documents({'tenancy_id', 'created_at'>=today_iso}) - correct though note photo size cap 10MB only enforced after full upload - a stream limit would be nicer for huge files; acceptable in current scope.

routes/tenant_portal.py:239-241 snag doc sets reported_by='Tenant: <name>', tenancy_id for traceability. Also logs tenant_portal message with direction='in' and emails the owner (reply_to tenant_email) - good two-way flow.

frontend/src/components/overpayment-planner.tsx:12-26 simulate() correctly caps bal at Math.max(0, loan-lump) and uses rate=0 fallback (loan/n) to avoid NaN. Returns {months, interest, balance}; interest-saved = base.interest - plan.interest (floored at 0 via Math.max).
frontend/src/components/overpayment-planner.tsx:44 early-returns when !loan; home-finance-card.tsx:50 mounts the planner only in personal purpose (via home-finance-card wrapper).
frontend/src/components/tenancy-actions.tsx:38 statement button disabled={!t.tenant_email} prevents the 400 'no email' path from the UI; tap of a tenant without email will not fire the mutation.

frontend/src/components/tenancy-actions.tsx:39 'Tenant portal' button is a smart toggle: if t.portal_url exists it reopens the sheet, otherwise it calls create.mutate() and then opens on success - good UX; share uses Share.share with message+url; revoke invalidates rentals query.
frontend/app/snags.tsx:96 renders `· ${item.reported_by}` when present - verified on screen for tenant-submitted repair.

frontend/app/tenancy-form.tsx:12,27 EMPTY includes statements_auto:true as default; existing tenancy load coerces to !!value - prevents stale strings. Chips update local state and PUT body includes statements_auto; backend TenancyIn.statements_auto defaults to True (rentals.py:43).

routes/tenant_portal.py:111 dedup check uses find_one by (tenancy_id, year) with projection {_id:1} - cheap. However run_january_statements iterates all tenancies irrespective of user; this is intentional (scheduler) but should be documented so admins know the scope.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - overpayment-planner reactive, rentals card buttons tappable, tenant-portal-sheet + copy/share/preview/revoke all reachable, tenancy-statements chips persist, tenant repair → snag flow verified

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via /auth?mode=login (demo@mybuilder.app / demo1234). BASE_URL = EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. tenant_email delivered@resend.dev is Resend's sandbox - safe. Server year is 2026 (confirmed by /api/rentals year chip). For statements, create tenancies with start_date at least 2 years ago (start_days_ago=800+) so a previous-year statement has rent due. For portal page assertions, parse the HTML returned by GET /api/t/<token>; all anchor ids are literal strings (tenancy-terms, deposit-status, rent-schedule, receipt-YYYY-MM, repair-form, prev-year, next-year, repair-sent-msg, print-receipt). run_january_statements can be exercised live only in January; outside Jan it's a no-op by design (today.month != 1 early return). Overpayment planner lives inside home-finance-card and only renders when project.purpose='personal' with deposit > 0 (loan > 0). For E2E, flip project via PUT /api/project {purpose:'personal', deposit: 30000, mortgage_rate: 5.0, mortgage_term: 25} and restore to investment+deposit=0 at the end.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. All spec requirements met and verified across backend + frontend.
